d:
RAW ka nam sabne suna hai. lekin ise khara karne vale R. N. Kao ki kahani kitne log jante hain? janie ‘Father of RAW’ ki kahani, shubhankar mishra ke satha.
Rameshvar nath kav kaun the? bharat ko ek alag bahri khuphiya ejensi ki zarurat kyon pari? aur kavsahab ne RAW ki ninv kaise rakhi? yah kahani hai us shakhs ki, jiska nam bharat ki khuphiya duniya ke itihas se jura hai.
Watch the story of R. N. Kao, the founder of RAW — Research and Analysis Wing — in this Hindi explainer with Shubhankar Mishra.
